name: Khondaker Arifur Rahman
title: Deputy Manager, Enterprise Systems & IT Operations Leader
organisation: Baridhi Garments Limited (Bitopi Group), Cumilla EPZ, Bangladesh
tagline: I run ERP and IT for garment manufacturing: networks, security, servers and the factory systems production depends on.
status: Open to Head of IT / Group IT Manager roles
about: ERP and IT operations leader with 12+ years in Bangladesh’s Ready-Made Garments sector, now running ERP and IT across Bitopi Group’s manufacturing units at Cumilla EPZ and reporting to the Group Sr. GM of ERP & IT.

I design and run enterprise networks (LAN, WAN, VPN, Cisco routing and switching), lead ISMS assessments and vulnerability management, and administer Windows and Linux servers, VMware and Hyper-V, Microsoft 365 and Active Directory. I also own the IT budget, vendor relationships and procurement, and the factory systems production depends on: CCTV, RFID, face recognition, access control and IP-PABX.

experience.role: Deputy Manager, Enterprise Systems & IT Operations Leader
experience.intro: Leads ERP and IT operations across the group’s manufacturing units.
points: Lead and oversee ERP and IT operations across manufacturing units, keeping systems stable, secure and scalable.
Act as the link between business users and technical teams, translating operational needs into ERP solutions.
Manage ERP system administration, user access control, process optimisation and compliance.
Supervise IT infrastructure: servers, networks, printers, backups and security policies.
Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, data accuracy and reporting.
Coordinate with vendors, consultants and internal stakeholders on system upgrades and support.
Mentor and guide the ERP & IT team, ensuring timely issue resolution and skill development.
wins: Optimised ERP processes for garment manufacturing operations, reducing manual work and operational delays.
Ran ERP user training and change management, raising adoption across Production, HR, Accounts and Commercial.
Led resolution of critical ERP performance, reporting and data-accuracy issues under tight deadlines.
Cut IT service response time by restructuring ticket handling and writing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Kept IT and systems at zero downtime during large-scale company events and operations.
Improved ERP reports used for management reporting and data analysis.
Maintained business continuity through regular backups, system monitoring and preventive maintenance.

points: Built the full digital infrastructure for head office and multiple factory locations, including LAN/WAN/VPN deployment and remote connectivity.
Conducted organisation-wide ISMS assessments and reduced risk through proactive vulnerability scanning and firewall implementation.
Led integration and support of Office 365, Exchange Server and Active Directory, improving internal communication and authentication security.
Supervised ERP operations, simplifying business processes and improving cross-departmental efficiency.
Managed IT budgeting, procurement and vendor relations for cost-effective hardware, software and licensing investments.
Provided executive-level reporting on IT performance, security incidents and infrastructure upgrades.
Coordinated business continuity planning, disaster recovery and regular employee security awareness training.
Ran next-generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security and VMware / Hyper-V virtualisation; managed CCTV, RFID, face recognition, access control, IP-PABX and Polycom systems.
Administered domain controllers, file servers, security systems and the virtualised server environment.
Administered the ERP system and MIS reporting, delivering accurate and timely reports to senior management.
Integrated the payroll system with IT infrastructure and kept HR and finance data consistent.
Delivered Level 2/3 support across hardware, software, network and peripherals; kept IT asset records current.
Configured Microsoft 365 and Outlook and managed user accounts through Active Directory.
Managed LAN/WAN, wireless and VPN connectivity; configured Cisco switches and routers.
Administered CCTV, access control and video conferencing systems.
Maintained Windows servers (file, print, DHCP, DNS) and online/offline UPS/IPS for critical equipment.
Provided end-user support, wrote technical documentation and kept hardware and software asset registers.
Designed and deployed client networks: router administration, interface configuration, RIP and OSPF.
Configured Cisco switches and routers for LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi; tuned and troubleshot network performance.
Analysed client workflow, access and security requirements to specify infrastructure; supported Windows Server and Linux.
Rotated through IT operations, infrastructure management and business processes; handled IT support, hardware maintenance and network operations.
Six-month internship covering telecom infrastructure, switching systems and network operations.
